acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce actual v1 producer versus standalone trace-semantic verifier disagreement on a pinned synthetic repository.
Adjudicate authority and zero-outcome expectations against the governing contract without regenerating frozen expectations from candidate output.
Add an actual-producer conformance regression and investigate the separately suspected v1 Unicode canonical hash discrepancy.
body: Confirmed while implementing issue408 on base 4663ce7c0f079a111e5e1a6f08de80ae703730e2 (Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163, Tasks0.8.1 build202). The inherited v1 path in conformance/dashboard-snapshot-v0/trace_snapshot_multi.go expects ADVISORY source/inventory authority and only present outcome buckets. Actual cmd/corvint-dashboard-snapshot producer emits ADAPTER_QUALIFIED and all three outcome buckets including zeroes. Synthetic one-row v1 fixture reproduced byte_equal=false, actual usage rows9 expected7. Reproduction source /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/issue408-inherited-v1-reproduction.go and log issue408-inherited-v1-reproduction.log. The temporary test was removed after execution. Existing conformance tests compile their own expected snapshots without this actual-producer comparison. V2 interoperability is separately fixed/tested in issue408; preserve frozen v1 fixture provenance until adjudicated. Also SUSPECTED, not yet a separate confirmed reproduction: v1 canonical trace hashing uses snapshot strconv.Quote encoder, which may disagree with production ASCII escaping on Unicode tasks; investigate independently.
title: Dashboard v1 trace conformance expected snapshot differs from actual producer
